# KUKA KRL Editor

KUKA KRL Editor is a free browser-based editor for KUKA Robot Language (KRL), developed by CAD/CAM Systeme Datentechnik Reitz GmbH & Co. KG.

Main product page: https://cnc-technik.de/kuka
GitHub Pages landing page: https://cncandi.github.io/kuka-krl-editor/
Repository: https://github.com/cncandi/kuka-krl-editor
Community library: https://cnc-technik.de/robsimul/roblib/?tab=krl

## What it does

- Edit KUKA .src and .dat files
- Syntax highlighting for KUKA Robot Language
- Code completion for KRL keywords, variables and functions
- Go to Definition for declarations across open files
- WorkVisual .wvs and .wvps support
- Robot archive .zip support
- KRL tools such as array assistant, position mirroring, data list sorting and program splitting

## Intended audience

Robot programmers, KUKA integrators, CNC and automation companies, technical schools, students and engineers working with KUKA industrial robots.
